Allow is disabled until at least one Toolset and a scope are chosen; the API also refuses an empty Toolset list (consent.tsx; oauth-grants/routes.ts Choice schema).

Offered Toolsets are those the Client requested as toolset:<id>, inside the organization ceiling, with Tools for the person's account type; Administration only for Administrators (oauth-grants/routes.ts facts()).
Read and write is offered only when the request includes write and the organization is not read-only (oauth-grants/routes.ts writeOffered).
The signed consent query lasts 600 seconds, so ten minutes (apps/api/src/auth/oauth.ts codeExpiresIn 600; oauth-provider signParams exp; TECH-035 #1135 addendum).

Consent-page refusal messages for expired_query, mcp_disabled, group_disabled, client_unlisted and client_disabled; a refused page offers Deny alone and an expired page offers no actions (consent.tsx).

Connected Clients rows show Client name, Toolsets, a Read or Write pill, 'Granted {date}' and 'Last used {date}' with Disconnect; confirmation dialog 'Revoke OAuth grant' with 'Revoke' (connected-clients.tsx; mcp-scope.tsx; api-keys.tsx).
Settings → Personal → API keys is the staff path; Business Users are redirected to /portal/settings/api-keys (settings.tsx; settings-api-keys.tsx).

A revoked, expired or switched-off grant is refused with 401 on the next MCP call; an expired grant clears remembered consent and needs new consent (oauth-grants.ts liveOAuthGrantFor and authorize hook; mcp/auth.ts; e2e/tests/63-m41-oauth.spec.ts final 401).
Guide Tools openlaw_whoami, openlaw_docs_search and openlaw_docs_read are always in an OAuth grant (mcp/register.ts; mcp/guide.ts; mcp/auth.ts).
The four seeded Allowed Clients start enabled (packages/db/migrations/0171_m41-oauth-clients.sql; enabled default true).

Claude's published identity is https://claude.ai/oauth/mcp-oauth-client-metadata with callback https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback; Claude Code's is https://claude.ai/oauth/claude-code-client-metadata (migration 0171; allowed-clients.ts).
Published identities have no Client secret; the secret route refuses them (modules/mcp-settings/allowed-clients.ts).
No dynamic client registration is needed; it is off by default and CIMD admits enabled published identities (oauth.ts cimd isMetadataDocumentUrlAllowed; migration 0171 default false).
The OpenLaw API fetches the published identity document (oauth.ts fetchClientMetadataResource).
The linked anchors connect-headless-client.md#connect-claude-cowork-or-claude-desktop, configure-mcp.md#enable-oauth-clients and both deployment profiles exist (structural build passes).
limitations: Source inspection only. It does not replace the browser walkthrough and live-provider check the scenario requires against 067c1646.

A disabled or unlisted Client is refused at /api/auth/oauth2/authorize with HTTP 400 and the text 'Client is not on the enabled Allowed Clients list.' before sign-in. The browser shows the raw error body, not the consent page. The consent-page messages for an unlisted or disabled Client appear only when the Administrator changes the Client after the flow started. The guides describe both.
The negative check 'account groups are refused' is met on the consent page by 'OAuth Clients are off for your account type.' and on existing grants by a 401 on the next call.

Claude steps: Customize → Connectors, + then Add custom connector, Advanced settings for OAuth Client ID and secret, Add, Connect, + → Connectors in a conversation, the Team and Enterprise Owner path Organization settings → Connectors → Add → Custom → Web, and Desktop and Cowork sharing the account's remote connector: vendor instruction, checked against the linked vendor page on 2026-09-25 (support.claude.com article 11175166).

Claude Code steps: claude mcp add --transport http with --scope user, /mcp browser sign-in, and automatic CIMD discovery: vendor instruction, checked against the linked vendor page on 2026-09-25 (code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp).
Whether claude.ai completes CIMD with DCR off, and the protocol revision it negotiates, are listed as unverified in DD-029 and need the live-provider check.
